title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium on 1982-12-27
lineage: Playback on Nakamich BX-100 > Panasonic SV 3700 DAT> Tascam CD-RW 700> EAC > WAV > FLAC
source: FOB  Sennheiser 441s > Sony D5 > Sony D5 (first gen CM)

ai_review.summary: All‑time great second set highlighted by a smoking Scarlet Begonias, captured on an audience tape of decent but not stellar sound quality.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the strength of the second‑set list, especially the intense Scarlet Begonias solo. The recording is an audience (AUD) source that isn’t crystal clear but is considered better than many other crowd tapes. Overall the show shines despite modest audio fidelity.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is rated very high (all‑time great second set) while recording quality is only fair; the weighted average yields a solid 4+ rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound quality is not great—some muddiness and crowd noise—but better than many other AUD recordings.

show_quality.setlist_flow: All‑time great second‑set list with strong momentum and tight transitions.
